open_points.subject: Mapped node input cardinality (`map_over`)
open_points.text: A05 rule 1 phase 5: "a `many` output feeds ... a `one` input that is its node's `map_over` port"; A03 rule 3: "A mapped node (M14) calls `run` once per element with that element in place of the mapped port's list."
open_points.question: For a mapped node, must the `map_over` input port be cardinality `one` or `many`, and what shape is validated/stored before per-element calls?
options: `map_over` port must be `one`; incoming `many` list is a mapping envelope and each call receives one element
`map_over` port must be `many`; each call receives one element as a special runtime substitution
allow both, with distinct validation/runtime rules
open_points.default_guess: `map_over` port is `one`, with explicit special-case validation for the incoming `many` source before element-wise execution.

open_points.subject: Guard semantics when source outputs are `many` (mapped outputs)
open_points.text: A13 rule 4: "A guarded edge delivers only when its guard port's value equals its guard value." A05 phase 5: "Every output of a mapped node is `many` for its consumers."
open_points.question: If a guard port value is `many` (list), is guard comparison evaluated per element, on the whole list, or prohibited by proof?
options: evaluate one equality on the whole list value
refuse guarded edges whose guard port is `many`
open_points.default_guess: Refuse guards on `many` guard ports at proof time to avoid ambiguous per-element semantics.

open_points.subject: Capture-from-run eligibility after run end
open_points.text: State 0 action failure for capture: refusal lists "succeeded, skipped, another contract version, or ... run was already released"; A15 rule 5: capture is "allowed only while its run still holds its spool — the run has not ended, or ended `failed` and was not released — and is refused otherwise."
open_points.question: Is capture from a failed NodeExecution in an ended non-`failed` run (e.g., `refused`/`cancelled`) always refused, even when needed inputs are non-file values still in store?
options: allow capture whenever execution is eligible and required inputs still exist, regardless of run end status
allow capture only while spool is retained (A15 strict rule)
allow capture from ended runs only when execution had no file inputs
open_points.default_guess: Use A15 strict rule: refuse capture unless spool is still retained (running or ended `failed` and not released).
